items.title: In response to yesterday's bombing at the Shrine of Lal Shahbaz Qalandar that killed 88 people, the Pakistan Army claims to have killed more than 100 terrorists and arrested many others.
A mudslide in Saint Bernard, Southern Leyte, Philippines, has buried more than 300 homes and an elementary school. An estimated 300 people are killed, with more than 1500 missing.
